properties.name: Elsham Tech Park
properties.summary: Outline application for up to 1 gigawatt of computing equipment power across up to 15 data halls on about 435 acres of agricultural land, including a large share of best and most versatile farmland. The planning committee was minded to approve in March 2026, but the council portal still records no decision issued (checked 2026-07-15); we list the site as in planning until the decision notice appears. A recommended condition caps non-domestic water at 20 m³ a day for each business on site, subject to an approved cooling strategy (committee report PA/2025/643); no annual total is published.
